subject: Television & Streaming
title: House of Cards Changes the Game
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: House of Cards Changes the Game.

hook.text: In 2013, Netflix released all 13 episodes of House of Cards at once. Nobody had ever done that before.

buildup.text: Traditional networks aired one episode per week to build anticipation. Netflix said: let people watch however they want.

discovery.text: The binge model exploded. Viewers watched entire seasons in a weekend. A new behavior was born overnight.

twist.text: Netflix used viewing data to greenlight the show. They knew their audience wanted political drama before asking them.

climax.text: House of Cards proved a streaming platform could produce prestige TV as good as anything on HBO or cable.

punchline.text: Netflix didn't just stream TV. It became TV.

quiz.question: What was revolutionary about House of Cards' release strategy?
options: All episodes were released at once for binge-watching
It was filmed entirely on smartphones
